title: Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web platforms record user and item activity in relational databases whose schemas differ from platform to platform, which makes it difficult to transfer predictive models between them. Relational foundation models address this through cross-database pretraining, yet recent improvements have relied on increasingly large pretraining corpora. We ask whether a better architecture, together with features specific to the target database, can deliver comparable gains from far less pretraining data. We introduce MoREGT, a mixture-of-relational-experts graph transformer that represents both rows and cells as tokens, adds the log-ages of rows and the names of foreign-key relationships to attention, and routes cells and rows to experts by column metadata rather than by values. translated_title: 跨模式专家：面向跨数据库泛化的智能体引导的关系专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 网络平台将用户和物品的活动记录在关系数据库中，而各平台的数据库模式彼此不同，这使得预测模型难以在平台之间迁移。关系型基础模型通过跨数据库预训练来解决这一问题，但近来的性能提升依赖于日益庞大的预训练语料库。我们探究：更好的架构设计，结合目标数据库特有的特征，能否用远少于以往的预训练数据实现相当的性能提升。我们提出MoREGT，一种关系专家混合图Transformer，它将行和单元格均表示为token，在注意力机制中引入行的对数时间戳和外键关系名称，并根据列元数据而非取值将单元格和行路由至相应专家。一个对标签无感知的LLM智能体对该模型形成补充：它读取目标数据库的模式和列统计信息，并添加经过验证的单行派生列，且无法访问标签数据。
tldr: 该论文提出MoREGT关系专家混合图Transformer，通过基于列元数据的专家路由和标签无感知的LLM智能体自动生成派生特征，证明更好的架构设计与目标数据库特征相结合能够以远少于现有方法的预训练数据实现跨数据库泛化性能。
en_tdlr: MoREGT, a mixture-of-relational-experts graph transformer guided by a label-blind LLM agent for validated derived features, achieves cross-database generalization with far less pretraining data through better architecture design and target-database-specific features.
